raw_response:
I’m old now, so I don’t chase fancy things. I do what has kept the family fed. On my 8.5 mu, I will still keep most land in wheat-maize because that is the steady road here, and I keep a smaller piece in cotton for extra cash. Money is not loose in the house, and some people work outside, so I cannot depend on a lot of hired help. If I put too little fertilizer, I worry the crop will fall flat; if I put too much, I waste cash. So I stay near what worked for me before: wheat a bit heavier, maize moderate, cotton not too much because it eats labor. Since I have well water, I will save irrigation for the key times and not pump more than needed because electricity and water both cost money.
